avas.name: Submission of AVA petitions
avas.boundary_excerpt: (c) Purpose and effect of submission of AVA petitions. The submission of a petition under this subpart is intended to provide TTB with sufficient documentation to propose the establishment of a new AVA or to propose changing the name or boundary of an existing AVA. avas.boundary_excerpt: (c) Modification of an existing AVA—(1) Boundary change. This evidence or information must include, at a minimum, the following:
